== Ozma of Oz / A Record of Her Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas, the Yellow Hen, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion, and the Hungry Tiger; Besides Other Good People too Numerous to Mention Faithfully Recorded Herein ==

Evardo is a prince of Ev, one of four princes and five princesses born to the Queen of Ev, all of whom resemble one another closely except in size. He is older than his brother Evring. As the eldest of the royal children, Evardo stood to inherit his father's throne and be crowned King of Ev upon returning to his own country; he is described as a grave and quiet youth who would rule his people wisely and with justice.

After the Queen was relieved of her enchanted duties, she presented Evardo to the assembled subjects from a palace balcony as their future ruler, proclaiming him "King Evardo Fifteenth" — fifteen years of age, wearing fifteen silver buckles on his jacket, and the fifteenth Evardo to rule the land of Ev. The people cheered their approval fifteen times, and even the Wheelers present pledged their obedience to the new King. The Queen then set a crown of gold, adorned with rubies, upon his head and draped an ermine robe over his shoulders, formally proclaiming him King. Evardo bowed gratefully to his subjects before going off to look for cake in the royal pantry.

=== Events ===

* The Queen's eldest son is crowned King Evardo Fifteenth of Ev in a public ceremony.
